name: sofer
description: Transcribe shiurim and search your Torah learning material in Sofer.Ai.

interface.longDescription:
Transcribe and study shiurim, and search your Torah.

Sofer.Ai helps you review and explore Torah learning through searchable transcripts of shiurim and lectures, including recordings that mix English, Hebrew, Yiddish, and Aramaic.

Upload an audio file or share a direct audio link or supported recording-page link. Choose how Hebrew words appear—Hebrew letters, English transliteration, or Hybrid—or use your saved preference. You can request speaker labeling, follow transcription progress, and organize recordings into folders.

Ask questions about material in your Sofer.Ai knowledge base and receive answers grounded in retrieved passages, with links back to the sources and audio timestamps when available.

A Sofer.Ai account is required. Transcription uses your existing Sofer.Ai allowance or balance.
defaultPrompt: What do my Sofer.Ai shiurim say about this topic?
Summarize this completed shiur and include source links.

review.commerce_description: A Sofer.Ai account is required. Transcription consumes the existing Sofer.Ai allowance or balance. Plans and credits are purchased and managed on the Sofer.Ai website. The plugin does not offer a checkout or purchase tool.

publication.release_notes: Icon update: beige background and additional padding around the original Sofer.Ai quill for visibility. No functionality changes.
